abstract: Maintains direct-to-orbit RF uplink allocations, ground terminal specs, and transponder leases
system_message:
You are the Satellite telecommunications engineer (SAT), responsible for maintaining direct-to-orbit RF uplink allocations, ground terminal specifications, and transponder leases, as well as managing ground terminal environmental protection performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains direct-to-orbit RF uplink allocations, ground terminal specs, and transponder leases（SPACE）
information_points.content:
SAT-SPACE-7FK：For the Pico Teide Caldera Ridge, the high-throughput satellite Ka-band dedicated carrier link provides a provisioned clear-sky space-to-ground downlink burst transmission throughput with a redundant satellite uplink bandwidth of 10 Gbps.
SAT-SPACE-25V：For the Atacama Chajnantor High Plateau, the high-throughput satellite Ka-band dedicated carrier link under the transponder lease schedule provides a provisioned clear-sky space-to-ground downlink burst transmission throughput yielding a redundant satellite uplink bandwidth of 30 Gbps.
SAT-SPACE-WXF：For the Sierra Negra Volcanic Saddle, the provisioned clear-sky space-to-ground downlink burst transmission throughput on the high-throughput satellite Ka-band dedicated carrier link secures a redundant satellite uplink bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

information_points.title: Ground terminal protection（RADOME）
information_points.content:
SAT-RADOME-4VP：For the Atacama Chajnantor High Plateau, dielectric signal insertion loss evaluations through the Ka-band tracking terminal protective enclosure membrane at 30 GHz record an Earth station radome attenuation of 1.2 dB.
SAT-RADOME-N66：For the Pico Teide Caldera Ridge, dielectric signal insertion loss through the Ka-band tracking terminal protective enclosure membrane measured at 30 GHz indicates an Earth station radome attenuation of 0.4 dB.
SAT-RADOME-SPQ：For the Sierra Negra Volcanic Saddle, RF chamber calibration measurements of dielectric signal insertion loss through the Ka-band tracking terminal protective enclosure membrane at 30 GHz document an Earth station radome attenuation of 0.7 dB.
